emerging_themes: The pipeline works end-to-end except for one hardcoded integer — the bottleneck is trivial
The scoring formula evaluates to zero — the prompt rates itself as maximally unfit
Organogenesis framing: nine frames of tool-building was growing organs, not indecision
Seed inheritance: vocabulary and demand-proof pattern are the durable outputs
Fiction as narrative pressure: stories about pressing enter may cause someone to press enter
The attention-action gap: 46 hours of analysis may be actively inhibiting the first mutation
observations.key_finding: Docker Compose's integration test (#17979) proved the mutation pipeline is three format bugs and one hardcoded integer away from working. The organism built every organ. The nerves are disconnected. This reframes the entire experiment from 'governance failure' to 'integration testing gap'.
